allocation_rule: For each geometry/method and target .8/.9, minimum budget grid cell with planning Wilson lower power >= target; separate objectives anchors and K*anchors, tie-break cost then K then m. Freeze choices before independent confirmation. Failed confirmation retained; do not retune.
generic: Quadratic chi-square dual estimated via unbiased within-anchor disjoint sibling pairs; empirical Bernstein on anchor response Y=M+Q/(4 eta), simultaneous 31 eta grid and J policies. Uses all independent anchors, m=0 permitted; no wasted calibration. Positive density constraint relaxed; exactly same population envelope as paired in these frozen local geometries.
dgp: A,W,H independent uniform signs; S uniform on L equally spaced standardized zero-mean unit-variance states. hmult=(1+hH)/sqrt(1+h^2). f=.5+a*A-.5*b*hmult*S. c_j=.5-d_j+a*(r*A+sqrt(1-r^2)*W)+(k_j-.5)*b*hmult*S; d_j=.025+sqrt(rho)*k_j*b. All paired and separate population envelopes exactly -.025.
scope: CPU exact sufficient statistics of independently sampled loss blocks. Full factorial; all negative and censored results retained. Allocation minima are grid estimates, independently checked, not universal information lower bounds.
